_doc: What a character believes, and therefore who they can stand to walk beside. Replaces the nine-point lawful/chaotic × good/evil grid. Party chemistry is computed from holds and despises (see Banter.initial_bond), so a creed only needs to say what it is for and what it cannot abide — there is no pairwise table to maintain as the pool grows.

_schema.display_name: Shown on the reveal and party screens.
_schema.blurb: One line, in the creed's own voice where possible.
_schema.text: The authored belief, a short paragraph.
_schema.holds: Values this creed is for. Shared vocabulary: order | freedom | mercy | ruin | truth | kin | coin | silence.
_schema.despises: Values it cannot abide. Overlap with another creed's holds is what makes two people grate.

the_kept_word.blurb: What was promised gets done, and the cost is not an argument against it.
the_kept_word.text: Order first, and mercy inside it. A rule that bends for the deserving was never a rule, and a rule that cannot feed a hungry child was never worth keeping either.

the_open_hand.blurb: Help whoever is in front of you. Work out the rest afterwards.
the_open_hand.text: No law and no banner, only the plain fact that somebody is cold and you are not. The rest is commentary.

the_unbroken_horse.blurb: Nobody's to command, and nobody's to leave in a ditch.
the_unbroken_horse.text: Freedom is the first good and kindness is the second, and anyone who says the first requires giving up the second is selling something.

the_straight_furrow.blurb: The rule holds or nothing does. Feelings are not a system.
the_straight_furrow.text: Order for its own sake, because the alternative has been tried in living memory and the fields are still black.

the_middle_road.blurb: Takes no side that has not first taken the trouble to be right.
the_middle_road.text: Every banner on this continent has been on the wrong end of its own argument. Walk between them and keep walking.

the_loose_rein.blurb: Owes nothing, holds nothing, asks nothing.
the_loose_rein.text: Freedom without a cause attached to it. It is not selfishness exactly; it is a refusal to be held, which looks the same from outside.

the_iron_ledger.blurb: Everything is owed to somebody. Collect on time.
the_iron_ledger.text: Order as an instrument. Rules are what let a strong hand take a weak one apart slowly, in daylight, with paperwork.

the_short_answer.blurb: Whatever is in the way stops being in the way.
the_short_answer.text: No banner and no restraint. Not cruelty for its own sake — simply nothing that has ever been allowed to weigh against getting what is wanted.

the_burning_field.blurb: It was all going to come down anyway. Better it comes down in a direction.
the_burning_field.text: Freedom and ruin together, which is the most dangerous pair on the continent, because it can always explain itself and never stops.
